span.p:
201 Created — file.status = SCANNING
(READY at once when the blob was scanned before)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
av-scan — every 5 s, leader only, small files first
read blob from SeaweedFS → decrypt → clamd INSTREAM (≤ 100 MB, larger = skipped_too_large → READY)
FS_AV_MODE=disabled (dev only) → READY with av_scan = skipped

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
READY · outbox file.created
download now allowed

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
QUARANTINED · download blocked (423)
every file sharing the blob is blocked too

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
stays SCANNING → SCAN_PENDING after 15 min (scan-pending-watch)
retried every 30 min (scan-pending-retry)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: relay — every 2 s: event_outbox → NATS subject files.{tenant}.{event}

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
content pipeline — 5 s fast lane / 60 s background:
detect → extract (Tika) → ocr (skipped) → nlp → embed (off) → index (Meilisearch)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
temp-score — every 6 h:
view/download counts + age → file.temperature_score

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
tier-migrate — every 24 h: hot → cool → cold by temperature
copy → re-read and verify sha256 of the ciphertext → cutover pointer → 30 min grace → delete old object

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
version-tier-sync — every 5 min (D-89):
blob of a superseded version → cool · updated current version → hot

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
tier-move-request — every 5 s:
admin-requested moves from file-fe /admin/tier (table tier_move_request)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DELETE /api/v1/files/{id} → user_file.removed_at for the caller
file becomes TRASHED only when the LAST co-owner removes it

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
gc — mark: ref_count = 0 → gc_candidate → sweep: delete bytes on primary AND standby
the MIRROR copy is never cleaned (known gap)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
janitor: session-sweep 5 min (expired chunked sessions release quota)
orphan-blob-sweep 6 h (tmp objects older than 24 h)
stuck-upload-sweep 15 min (UPLOADING > 2 h → FAILED)
